review.summary: Very dark blue cave, rough stone foreground, small real scuba diver moves through a gloomy opening; strongest mood fit from these stock sites.
review.limitations: Only eight seconds, visible diver, compressed/soft low-light photography. No established abyssal depth and no abundant fish. Not a seamless loop.

review.basis: Actual decoded source snapshots viewed; not continuous human playback or listening
review.summary: Large groups of real translucent jellyfish moving in rich blue lighting against dark negative space, long enough for an ambient passage.
review.limitations: Explicit tank/aquarium footage; saturation quite electric and photograph somewhat soft/noisy. Not open-ocean/abyss evidence and not a forward travel shot. Three snapshots cannot establish no flashes throughout.
